description: A small desert oasis vignette from the Little Structures datapack — a water pool ringed by sand with sparse vegetation and a few decorative props. A tidy, palette-clean vanilla build.

style_fit.rationale: Off-theme: a desert oasis has no place in the Mediterranean/coastal-ruin brief this run is filling, and it fills none of the current demand categories. Competent and license-clean, so it could be revisited only if a desert theme is ever scouted.
